summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False), a static render_speed(speed) method using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render() branch for unknown totals; module-level track() gained show_speed=True and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total as None for unsized sequences instead of raising, with task_total declared Optional[float]. Updated tests/test_progress.py (removed the two ValueError assertions, added test_task_progress_column_speed) and added a CHANGELOG line under Unreleased/Added. Nothing was run (per instructions), so pytest, strict mypy and black are unverified. No commits were made.
